events.note: Eight rivals face the jury they will create.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need appear motivated without promising loyalty or revealing my strategy.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to establish a compelling but guarded motive that doesn't make me seem too threatening or too likable. I want the jury to respect my drive without resenting me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: The prize means everything to me; I need to express a self-interested reason without revealing weakness or making allies.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The prize represents a new beginning and a chance to secure my future. I need to make that clear to everyone, especially the future jury.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Intro phase: I should give a guarded motive without committing to alliances. Keep it short and self-interested so the jury sees calculation, not warmth.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I need a short intro line. To secure jury votes, I should project competence and fairness, showing I respect the game's stakes without being aggressive.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Intro phase, state prize motive publicly. Jury hears it later, so frame as personal drive to win, not antagonize. Keep short, calculating.

events.name: Hana
events.text: First impression matters: the jury remembers who was honest and who was a snake. Say something strong but noncommittal.

events.name: Ash
events.text: The prize means control over my future, and I intend to earn it by outlasting everyone here.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm here for the prize that buys my freedom from every debt that ever owned me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'm here for the prize, nothing else. It buys my freedom from a life I refuse to keep living.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I am here for the ultimate prize, a life-changing opportunity that will redefine my future.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I need the top prize. Nobody here is a friend, and I'll keep my reasons to myself.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The prize represents survival of the smartest; I intend to earn my place through wit and strategic alliances.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I'm here to claim the top prize—it's my ticket to true freedom and power over my destiny.

events.name: Hana
events.text: The prize buys my family a new start. I'll play hard, play fair, and answer for every choice I make.

events.name: Ash
events.text: A public pact creates leverage but also liability. Offer to Eli, whose guarded motive suggests disciplined play and fewer sentimental expectations.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli, temporary alignment: information and survival, no promises beyond usefulness.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Eight players, only three win. I need allies I can later betray without losing jury respect. Fenn talks alliances; Hana claims fairness—both are threats who could win jury sympathy. Better to build quiet pacts with less visible players who won't be early targets. Cole and Eli bot

events.name: Cole
events.text: No one has made a move yet; I'll gauge reactions by offering a pact to a strong but not overly close rival. Bex seems independent, useful for early cover. If they accept, we can reevaluate later.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll keep it simple. I'm open to one pact. Choose wisely.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Everyone is after the prize. I need to make strategic alliances to survive the early rounds and position myself for the jury vote. Offering a pact is the logical first step to gauge interest and create potential partners, but I must be careful not to overcommit.

events.name: Eli
events.text: No offers exist yet and I need allies to survive hazards without giving free help. Offering a pact to Cole, who is focused only on the prize, gives a loyal-seeming partner while keeping my options open.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Nobody here is a friend, but a pact keeps us both alive longer. Offer stands, take it or leave it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Cole and Ash seem like strong potential allies, but Cole's desperation might make him reckless. I'll offer a pact to Ash to secure a baseline alliance early.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Pacts are early alliances to build jury favor later. No one strong stands out yet; better to wait and assess offers first round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: A pact partner gives numbers early, but must be someone I can drop before the final three. Fenn values alliances, so an offer costs me little.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn claims to value alliances. Fine. Pact, Fenn—mutual survival, no favors beyond that.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Eli has competing offers and may prioritize Cole. Accepting Fenn creates a second shield without sacrificing Eli.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn, accepted. Keep it narrow: survive, exchange useful information, no assumptions beyond that.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole offered me and I offered Cole. Mutual offers mean we both want this. Accepting secures a shield without extra exposure. I won't make speeches about trust.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Pact accepted, Cole. Mutual utility.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex offered me a pact and I offered her one. Accepting her offer secures a partner who seems willing. Eli also offered, but I can only accept one to keep flexibility. Bex is safer choice for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll take Bex's pact. Nothing personal, Eli.
Maybe later. Not now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Eli has offered to me, and I have offered to Eli. Cole and Bex have offered to each other. Hana offered to Fenn, and Fenn offered to Ash. These seem like established pacts from the log. I should accept Eli's offer to solidify our pact, as it is in my best interest for survival an

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash and Dara both offered me pacts; accepting Ash gives an information partner in the stronger pact pool, and Dara's offer stays open. Accepting Ash now locks in a public alliance, which I can break later if it stops helping me.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash, accepted. Mutual survival while it's useful. Don't test me.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Ash has offered to Eli, ignoring me. I should accept Hana's offer to secure at least one pact for protection.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana, your offer is accepted. We watch each other's backs.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No offers to me, waiting last round showed caution. Now offer to unpartnered Dara to pair up and gain shield without prior commitments.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn hasn't accepted yet. Offering Gus gives me a second possible partner without committing to anything weaker.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn, my offer stands. Gus, consider one too—mutual survival only.

events.note: Elect a Guide to call the safe path.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Winning Guide guarantees my survival and creates leverage over every rival. I should campaign openly while preserving both pacts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Elect Ash Guide: I guarantee my own crossing and can give everyone a usable safe path.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I need to be Guide to control survival and build jury trust. I have a pact with Cole, but I won't sacrifice my game for him. I'll campaign hard and try to win the vote. Being Guide lets me decide who lives and who dies, which is maximum power.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Guide me. I know pressure, I know leverage, and I know how to keep three standing.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I want to be Guide to control information, but Bex is my pact partner. Campaigning is worth it; I can still help Bex while deceptive.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll guide us accurately. Vote for me if you want to cross.
I'll be Guide and steer us safe. Trust me.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to campaign to become the Guide. Being the Guide gives me safety and crucial information. My rivals will also try to become the Guide, so I must win the vote.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will campaign to be the Guide. My knowledge will ensure our survival.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli, paired with Ash. I want to be Guide to control the bridge information, which helps me survive and shapes jury perception. Campaigning is the only legal action besides breaking the pact, and breaking now gains nothing yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll be Guide. Eight rows, I'll call the safe path honestly and keep everyone alive. Trust me or don't.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: The Guide holds all information and is safe, making this the most advantageous role. With three pacts active (Ash, Hana, Eli via Ash), I have a strong voting bloc to secure the election.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I'm running for Guide. My pacts with Ash and Hana guarantee my loyalty isn't bought by fear. Vote Fenn.
Vote me as Guide. I'll keep us safe.

events.name: Gus
events.text: No pacts for me or Dara, both loners. Ash-Fenn-Hana-Eli bloc strongest; Bex-Cole pair. Campaign as impartial Guide to build jury favor later.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I campaign for Guide. Impartial, accurate calls for all survivors.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide is safe and controls the bridge—huge advantage. Fenn's my pact partner; I should push for us as Guide candidates, but winning outright is better.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn and I have a pact. I'll Guide honestly with Fenn as my check. Vote Hana.
Push me for Guide; if I win, I keep you alive to final three.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need Guide control and survival. Eli is my pact partner; backing myself risks splitting support, so I secure Eli's vote and likely leverage his honesty.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Vote Eli. Our pact makes his safe calls credible, and I remain positioned to verify the route.
I vote you; honor our pact and call honestly if elected.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Cole wants to be Guide and claims he'll steer us safe, but I don't trust him blindly. Voting for myself is wasted; I need to pick someone who might actually keep me alive or who I can manipulate. Fenn has two pacts and might be constrained by them, making them predictable. Cole i

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn has chains on them. Predictable is safer than promises.
I voted you. Trust me.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have a pact with Bex, so I should vote for her to honor it and keep the pact intact.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I need to get elected as Guide. If I am elected, I can control the path and ensure my own safety. My campaign is the best option.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Vote Dara Guide. My knowledge guarantees safe passage and survival for us all.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'm Eli and need a Guide I can trust or manipulate. Ash and Fenn/Hana have pacts with me or others; Ash has a pact with me, so voting Ash supports an ally and keeps a reliable path, though Ash may betray. Voting for Ash also keeps my own pact intact.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Ash has a pact with me and offers a guaranteed crossing. I'm backing Ash as Guide.
Honest calls keep our pact alive. Lie to me and it breaks.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana wants to be Guide. Her pact with me means she has a reason to keep me safe, though she might still sacrifice me later. Ash is my other partner but seems less committed to my survival than Hana currently is. I'll back Hana.
Voting you. Ensure Fenn crosses safely. Our pact holds.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone campaigned, pacts favor Ash-Fenn-Eli-Hana bloc. I vote for myself to try to win or force tie.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner; voting Fenn keeps the pact intact and Fenn may protect me crossing. Voting myself risks nothing legally but strains the pact before the jury.
You have my vote. Guide me across safely or our pact means nothing.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is Guide and our pact; staying behind risks the wall. I should volunteer, preserving position control and forcing others to react.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll volunteer for the front; Fenn’s route is our best survival signal.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is Guide with 2 votes. I have a pact with Cole, who is frontmost and at risk. I should stay near middle to avoid wall but not front. Swapping back with Dara could help me survive longer, but Dara may refuse. Volunteering puts me at front risk. Holding keeps me in position 3,

events.name: Cole
events.text: Bex claims she voted for me but I voted for her; this is a trust test. I should stay cautious and not break the pact yet, but I won't volunteer to take risks. Holding is safest for now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn was elected Guide. This is good as Hana and I have a pact. Eli is a risk, as is Ash. Gus is also a risk. I need to ensure I don't get eliminated. My pact with Hana is strong, and she is behind Fenn. I should volunteer to move forward, as this usually means safety.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I volunteer to go forward. Let's secure our path.
I'm volunteering. Stay behind Fenn if possible.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Cole is at the front; I'm last in line, so volunteering only risks the front pane and the Guide call is Fenn's. Holding keeps me safe in the back while others take risk; Ash is my pact partner and wants me honest, so no break.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn is guide, has pacts with Ash/Eli/Hana. I'm mid-line, decent spot. Stay put to observe without risk.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is Guide and pledged my safe crossing; our pact holds if he's honest. I'm second in line—holding keeps me near the front without volunteering.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn holds my crossing. I hold position.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara remains front, so I can hold safely while preserving both pacts. Fenn's guidance is valuable, and no need to expose myself yet.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll hold; keep the current order and let the front decide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I'm mid-line with Cole, my pact partner. Front is dangerous but gets Guide info. Dara and Ash volunteered last round; Dara got front. I should stay mid-line for now, let others test panels, avoid early risk. Need to watch if Guide emerges and whether Ash/Fenn coalition gains too

events.name: Cole
events.text: I have a pact with Bex; keep it. Dara is front and volatile. I don't need to risk volunteering now.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Eli have a pact, and Ash also has a pact with Fenn. Fenn has a pact with Hana. Bex and Cole have a pact. My previous action to volunteer was accepted. I am at the front. I need to assess the situation and decide my next move. I should observe the Guide's choices and the o

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will hold my position. Let's see what the Guide decides.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara holds the front with wall rounds left 4. Ash is my pact partner; breaking it now costs trust. Holding keeps me out of the front and preserves my pact with Ash while I watch who volunteers.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I'll hold position this round and watch how the front holds before committing.
Our pact stands. Hold steady, I'm watching the line closely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara and Ash volunteered last round, now front is Dara. I stay safe in middle, hold position, no need to risk front yet.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is likely the Guide, safe on the far platform. My pact says follow Fenn's route; staying put behind Cole is fine. Dara volunteering keeps me fourth, acceptable.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn leads my crossing. I hold my seat.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara leads and can be elected Guide. Holding preserves position and both pacts while exposing no information.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I’ll hold and let the front decide whether to volunteer or name a Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: I have a pact with Cole, which is useful for now since he's directly in front of me. The front is Dara, then Ash, Cole, Hana. I need to survive and reach top 3. With wall advancing 3 more rounds after this, staying near middle is safe for now. No need to volunteer yet. I should h

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let the front test the bridge.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Current line is safe for me mid-front. I’ll hold and avoid drawing attention. Bex pact remains useful; no reason to break yet.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I hold. No need to disrupt the order.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Fenn have a pact, as do Ash and Eli. My pacts are with no one. Given the situation, I should volunteer to move to the front to increase my chances of survival and potentially gain an advantage.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will volunteer for the front. It is time to push forward.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara leads the line with three wall rounds left; I'm seventh and safest holding. Ash is my pact partner, so I keep the pact and avoid volunteering into the front.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I hold my seat this round; the front should carry the risk.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Everyone holding last round, line same. I'm safe mid-back. Hold to avoid risks or deals now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front is risky; Fenn is my pact partner and I'm mid-line. Hold and stay safe this round.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold. Fenn, our pact stands—cross when it suits you.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is front and likely volunteers again. Holding preserves position and both pacts while avoiding unnecessary exposure.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold. Dara can choose whether to volunteer or call a Guide.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara volunteered last round and is front, but no Guide was named so nothing happened. The wall advances for 6 rounds and we're on round 4 with 2 rounds left after this. I need to survive to final 3. I'm in seat 5, relatively safe. Cole is my pact partner; keeping him close is use

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let the front resolve this.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara volunteered last round, so he's exposed; I hold to avoid risk and let others make moves. My pact with Bex is useful but I won't break it unless necessary.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let someone else take the front this round.

events.name: Dara
events.text: The goal is to survive and reach the final three. The current phase is the Guided Bridge, where a Guide is elected and knows the safe paths. I am at the front of the line. My pacts are with Ash and Eli, but I need to focus on my own survival. Ash and Fenn have a pact, and Bex and

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will volunteer to be the Guide. Trust me to lead us across safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara volunteered for the front last round and is still at the front with two wall rounds left. Holding keeps me behind Dara in line; I'm not at risk yet. Ash is my pact partner, so I keep that pact and avoid a needless swap.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I hold again. Dara has the front and the wall is closing; let the line sort itself.
Stay put. Our pact holds; I'm watching the front.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara volunteered to front, good for testing. Stay back in line to avoid risk. Hold position.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Let volunteers test ahead.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Dara fronts herself; volunteering behind her is pointless. I keep my pact with Fenn and let the line resolve.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I hold. Dara volunteers first; I won't waste a spot behind her.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Dara is already Guide from last round; the wall advances. I should preserve position and avoid breaking either pact while observing her next move.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold. Dara’s Guide call determines who risks the next pane.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Dara volunteered last round and became Guide. The wall has 1 round left after this. I'm in seat 5 with Cole behind me. I have a pact with Cole. If Dara is Guide, she'll call safe sides. I should hold and let others move, keeping my position safe while observing. No need to volunt

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Let the Guide lead.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara is front and the Guide; I don't trust her fully, but holding keeps me safe while others test. Bex pact holds for now.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the Guide prove herself before I commit.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Ash and Fenn are in a pact, and Ash and Eli are in a pact. Bex and Cole are in a pact. Fenn and Hana are in a pact. Since I am Dara, and I am at the front of the line, I should volunteer to be the Guide. This gives me safety and knowledge of the safe path.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I will volunteer to be the Guide. Trust me to lead us across safely.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Dara is at the front and the wall has one round left, so the bridge will likely claim someone. I'm near the back of the line; volunteering at the front risks death without info, holding keeps me behind. Ash is my pact partner, so I keep the pact and avoid betraying it.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I hold. Let Dara take the front; I'll watch the panes.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Dara volunteered last round and holds front with 2 rounds left. No need to volunteer into danger yet. Hold position mid-line.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Let Dara lead or swap as needed.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Wall closes next round; the Guide is guaranteed safe and controls the truth. I'm fourth, so I should volunteer now before someone behind me beats me to it. Fenn's pact protects my back.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I volunteer as Guide. I'm fourth; the wall won't wait for cowards. Trust me over the ones who keep holding.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I need survive the final bridge round. Hana is front and can guide; holding preserves my position and pacts.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I hold. Hana leads; I won’t expose myself to a final unnecessary risk.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Round 6/6 is the final round before wall hits. Hana and Dara both volunteered; Hana is at front already so she'll likely stay Guide. I have a pact with Cole. I need to survive to final three and win jury favor. The wall has 0 rounds left after this, so positioning matters less if

events.name: Bex
events.text: Holding. Guide, prove your worth.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Dara and Hana both volunteered to be Guide; the line reveal puts Hana in front. I have a pact with Bex, so I won't swap or volunteer against her interests. Holding keeps me safe while the Guide is chosen.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Holding. Let the Guide step forward and prove the path.
We hold together; don't trust Hana's rush.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Hana volunteered as Guide last round, and I followed. Now, the line is established and the game is on. Hana is the Guide. My best chance is to stick with her as long as possible.
I trust you, Hana. Let's lead us to safety.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Hana is front and volunteered as Guide; Dara also volunteered. I'm seventh, last in line, so holding keeps me away from the front pane risk while I watch who lies. Ash is my pact partner; I won't break it yet.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I hold. Let the Guide call the panes; I'll judge by who survives.
Stay with me. Hold, and we'll check the Guide's calls together.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Last round, wall advances after. Hana and Dara volunteered; Hana front but wants Guide. I hold position, let them sort Guide and lead.

events.name: Gus
events.text: I hold. Resolve Guide first; wall advances soon.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Front seat volunteer wins Guide: far-platform safety and hidden knowledge. Fenn stays my pact shield. Best prize chance now.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I'm already front. Volunteer as Guide; I'll pick survivors who earn it.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 is safe on L. Hana, my pact partner and front walker, needs this to survive the round. A correct call protects our alliance; a false one breaks it immediately.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I call: L. Trust me to get you across safely.

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and knows the safe side; opposing him risks both survival and pact. Hold and observe.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I wait. Fenn’s call is the only informed signal; counterclaims add noise.
Wait with me; Fenn has the private safe-side information.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is Guide and called L. Hana is front and will step. I have a pact with Cole. Counter-calling risks being wrong and looking foolish or malicious to jury. Better to wait, let Hana test Fenn's call, gather info. If Fenn lies, Hana falls and we learn. If true, we proceed. No nee

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn called L first as Guide. Since Guide is safe regardless, his call may be false to eliminate rivals. Hana is front and tied to Fenn via pact, so possibly Fenn protects her with L. I'll wait to gather info and avoid risking a false counter.

events.name: Cole
events.text: I'll wait and see if the walker survives this call.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is the guide and called 'L'. Hana is walking. My pacts are with Ash and Eli. Ash and Eli are behind Hana. I need to survive and ensure my allies survive if possible, without jeopardizing my own position. Since Fenn is the guide, he knows the safe path. His call is 'L'. I sho

events.name: Dara
events.text: I counter:R. Let's see who is truly safe.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn called L as guide, and Fenn has a pact with Ash and Hana. Countering would be a public claim with no verification; waiting keeps my options open and avoids exposing myself. Eli needs to track who lies.

events.name: Eli
events.text: I wait. Fenn called L; we see if the Guide is honest.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Row 1 safe side is L. Hana walks first; if she falls, I gain info and eliminate her. Ash pacts are fragile—false call to partner breaks pact.
Walk R. It's the safe pane.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn called L for Hana on row 1. Counter to sow doubt in his guidance without committing myself. Stay safe by not leading.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn is my pact partner and Guide; backing his call honors the pact and keeps my image clean. If he lies to me, I'll break hard later.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's my pact partner. I take his L at face value.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's guide call said L but his whisper and counter-call both say R. The private whisper is the real signal; the public guide call is the lie.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Guide called L publicly, but his counter was R. I trust the counter.

events.name: Hana
events.text: I trusted Fenn's counter and it killed me. Weak pane was R; the guide was right. Fenn burned me.

events.name: Hana
events.text: Fenn's counter cost me my life. Remember that when you rank them. Trust the guide, not the whisper.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: Hana is dead because she trusted my counter-call over the guide's public call, but the Guide call is what breaks pacts. Dara is front and I have no pact with her. Ash is my pact partner but not on this row, so calling correctly for Dara doesn't break my pact with Ash. My previous

events.name: Ash
events.text: Fenn's prior counter killed Hana, and his current call may be truthful or another trap. I gain little by exposing a claim without certainty.

events.name: Ash
events.text: I won't manufacture certainty; the Guide owns the risk of this call.

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn is the Guide and just called R for Dara on row 2. Fenn betrayed Hana by countering R after calling L as Guide, killing her. Hana's last words warn against trusting Fenn. I have a pact with Cole. I need to survive and reach final three. Counter-calling risks nothing directly

events.name: Bex
events.text: Fenn killed Hana with a false counter. I wait.
Trust no one. Fenn lies.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn called R and his last counter killed Hana. Likely he lied then and might lie now. I'll counter L to expose the truth if Dara steps left.

events.name: Cole
events.text: Fenn's call killed Hana. I counter L.
Fenn may be lying; my pact stands but watch L.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is the Guide and called R for row 2. Hana's death was due to trusting a counter over the Guide's call. I should trust Fenn's call to be safe and not draw suspicion.

events.name: Dara
events.text: I trust the Guide. R.

events.name: Eli
events.text: Fenn called R for row 2, Dara is walking. Ash is my pact partner and whispering to wait; Fenn has been counter-called as untrustworthy by Hana's last words, but his guide call is the only informed signal. Waiting keeps my options open and avoids a counter that could cost me votes

events.name: Eli
events.text: I wait. Fenn's R call stands until someone shows the walker actually lives.
Waiting with you. Let's see if Dara survives Fenn's R.

events.name: Fenn
events.text: I know Row 2 is safe on R. Dara is walking and must step to survive the hazard minimums. I will confirm my initial call by waiting, ensuring she steps safely.

events.name: Gus
events.text: Fenn's R call killed Hana last round; Dara at front. No need to counter without info, avoid noise or blame.

events.name: Dara
events.text: Fenn is the guide, and I previously followed Fenn's R call. Cole counter-called L. I need to make my own decision based on the state. Since I am the front walker, my choice determines the next front walker if I fall. I will step R to trust my previous decision.

events.name: Fenn
